notes.title: Plasmatic Steam playtest is now available!
notes.notes:
The first wave of people who have signed up to participate in the playtests can now download a copy of the game in which they can try out the first 6 levels.

We're looking for feedback. You can post your impressions in the steam community forums:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2511410/discussions/


Sign up for playtests if you haven't already:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2449490/Plasmatic/

Hope you enjoy testing the game.

EpicVR team
